Fill and label an auger; top it up & Every run or powder change & At least 14 of the 16 printed augers were filled: one per powder, plus a second for brown rice flour. Load an auger: mount it, seat its gear, remove the outlet tape &  & The operators reported 37 loads; the order of the runs alone needed 29. Tape was left on the outlet once (5~Aug); the feed check and a camera frame caught it. & A cartridge changer with a tape-free outlet seal \\

Repair the mechanism &  & The tilt servos seized (11~Aug; run excluded; repaired next day), a hinge screw backed out (11~Aug), and the tap collar caught under the mounting plate (19~Aug). & A tilt sensor; locknuts \\
